turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What's a break clause in a rental contract?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It lets you or the landlord end the tenancy early, usually after a set period like six months, with notice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I'm not stuck for the whole year?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly. Without one, you'd normally have to pay rent until the end of the fixed term, even if you leave.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Who booked the big meeting room all afternoon, Adam?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friends want to start a weekly game night and asked me to pick what we play.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A space survival game where we build a base together and try not to starve.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a pirate game where we sail one ship and everybody has a job, steering, sails or cannons.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a quick card battler, very competitive, matches only take ten minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done, that's all of them. Now I'd love your opinion.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a weekly night, I'd go with the pirate ship. Everyone has a role, and the funniest stories come out of it. The space base is great if your friends like planning, and the card game suits people who only drop in for a bit.
